SUBTITLE_BER1_IGD_006A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Of course, Chernov! 
But they have nowhere to go!

SUBTITLE_BER1_IGD_011A_CHER.en:
^1CHERNOV: ^7They have set up defenses
in the clocktower!

SUBTITLE_BER1_IGD_015A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Dimitri, find a better position
upstairs in that building!

SUBTITLE_BER1_IGD_032A_COMM.en:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7These animals raped
and marauded their way through
the motherland without mercy!!!

SUBTITLE_BER1_IGD_039A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Split up! You four, go through the courtyard!

SUBTITLE_BER1_IGD_040A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7The rest of you, clear the street!

SUBTITLE_BER1_IGD_042A_REZN_A.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Hunt them down in whatever corner they hide!

SUBTITLE_BER1_IGD_043A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7This place reeks of nightmares and madness.

SUBTITLE_BER1_IGD_045A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7But only the insane would stand against us!

SUBTITLE_BER1_IGD_063A_COMM.en:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7Citizens of Berlin! A ring of steel
surrounds your rotten city!

SUBTITLE_BER1_IGD_064A_COMM.en:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7We will crush all who dare
to resist the will of the Red army!

SUBTITLE_BER1_IGD_301A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7We will be killing at close quarters!

SUBTITLE_BER1_INT_000A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Cut slowly... Always, cut slowly...
Your blade is part of you...

SUBTITLE_BER1_INT_001A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7When you reach the head...
Start at the mouth.

SUBTITLE_BER1_INT_005A_CHER.en:
^1CHERNOV: ^7I do not think we will find
many bears in Berlin.

SUBTITLE_BER1_INT_008A_COMM_A.en:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7On the Fuhrer's birthday...
A barrage of Katyushka rockets will tear Berlin to pieces.

SUBTITLE_BER1_INT_009A_COMM_A.en:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7With your bullets... With your bayonets...
With your bare hands...

SUBTITLE_BER1_INT_010A_COMM.en: ^1COMMISSAR: ^7Do the same to their wretched soldiers!

SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_004A_CHER.en: ^1CHERNOV: ^7This is not war. This is murder.

SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_005A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7This is how you end a war, Chernov.

SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_006A_CHER.en:
^1CHERNOV: ^7This is madness!
Our rockets are tearing the city apart!

SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_030A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Stay on your guard...
They may be cowering in the dark.

SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_034A_RUR1.en:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7Killing me will not save you.
My comrades show no mercy.

SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_043B_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Dimitri, throw a Molotov down there!
Burn them!

SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_051A_REZN_A.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Stay low. Smoke can steal your breath.

SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_054A_REZN_A.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Complaining will not help... Just keep low.

SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_055A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7In Stalingrad, Dimitri and I
crawled through many smoke filled buildings.

SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_058A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Berlin will be in ruins
by the time war is over.

SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_068A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Look around you, Chernov...
Do you think these men will be denied their revenge?

SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_069A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Death comes only two ways,
fast or slow.

SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_070A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Chernov, you should learn from Dimitri...
He understands the nature of mercy killing.

SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_071A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7You should have shot them, Chernov.
It is only cruel to prolong an animal's suffering.

SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_083A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Give your eyes a moment
to adjust to the darkness.

SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_089A_RUR2.en:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7We are going to be crushed...
Or buried alive!

SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_091A_CHER.en: ^1CHERNOV: ^7We need to find a way out!

SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_093A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7There will be an exit at the other
end of the platform!

SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_094A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Keep firing! I need to get the gate open!

SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_201A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Move faster!
We have to escape the barrage!

SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_301A_RUR3.en:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7What mercy did you
show to our people!

SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_303A_RUR3.en: ^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7Wait... Wait!  He may help us!

SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_304A_RUR1.en: ^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7Help us?!!  He can die for us.

SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_405A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Find your targets as soon
as the lights come on.

SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_413A_REZN_A.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7We need to take out that MG!

SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_000A_RUR2.en:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7The building's still being shelled!!!
We could be killed!

SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_001A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Then die with your hands around
the throat of the enemy!!!

SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_005A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Keep him covered! Keep that flag raised!

SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_008A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7MG's, dead ahead. I count three of them!

SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_009A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7The rest of you, keep on them...
Do whatever it takes!

SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_010A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Obliterate those MG's before
they rip us to shreds!

SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_018A_SSHG.en: ^1S.S. HONOR GUARD: ^7For the glory of the Reich!

SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_019A_SSHG.en: ^1S.S. HONOR GUARD: ^7Give your lives for the Fuhrer!

SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_020A_SSHG.en: ^1S.S. HONOR GUARD: ^7Berlin will never be yours!

SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_034A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Be on your guard... 
They'll fight to hold every strong point they can!

SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_035A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Right flank! Get up on that balcony!

SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_037A_RUR1.en:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7(grunting as he struggles
with the door) GRRNAAAAR!

SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_038A_RUR1.en:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7It's being held from the other side...
I need help!

SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_041A_RUR2.en:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7AGAIN!... On three. One...
Two... Three... (GRUNT!)

SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_043A_RUR1.en:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7We must be nearing the roof...
Look how far we've come.

SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_044A_RUR2.en:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7We should throw these animals
over the edge!

SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_045A_RUR1.en:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7Sergeant, our comrades
from the rear echelon are flooding the building.

SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_046A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Let them feast on our scraps.
We should push onward... to victory.

SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_047A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Onward, and the glory of planting
the flag will be yours.

SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_048A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7The bloodied heart of the fascist empire
will soon beat for the last time!

SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_049A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7As this symbol of their decadence plummets,
so too will their wretched Reich.

SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_050A_SSHG.en: ^1S.S. HONOR GUARD: ^7For Germany! For the Fuhrer!

SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_053A_SSHG.en: ^1S.S. HONOR GUARD: ^7Give your lives for Germany!

SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_054A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7They have nowhere left to go! Move up!

SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_056A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Let them surrender their lives
to their lost cause!

SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_111A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Deal with it any way you can!

SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_001A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Steel yourselves, men.
For the final push to victory.

SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_002A_COMM_A.en:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7The SS honor guard defending
this building will fight to their last breath.

SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_003A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Today, we crush what remains
of their fascist Reich.

SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_004A_COMM.en:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7Show courage... Show strength...
Show pride... But show NO mercy.

SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_005A_REZN_A.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7As heroes we will return to Russia's embrace...

SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_006A_COMM.en:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7Crush the last remnants of resistance
and this night our flag will fly over this city...

SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_101A_CHER.en:
^1CHERNOV: ^7When he first spoke of Dimitri,
Reznov told tales of a hero...

SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_101B_CHER.en:
^1CHERNOV: ^7When he first spoke of Dimitri,
Reznov told tales of a hero...

SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_101C_CHER.en:
^1CHERNOV: ^7When he first spoke of Dimitri,
Reznov told tales of a hero...

SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_102A_CHER.en: ^1CHERNOV: ^7Someone we should all aspire to be like...

SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_102B_CHER.en: ^1CHERNOV: ^7Someone we should all aspire to be like...

SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_102C_CHER.en: ^1CHERNOV: ^7Someone we should all aspire to be like...

SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_103A_CHER.en:
^1CHERNOV: ^7His merciless brutality defines
him only as a savage...

SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_103B_CHER.en: ^1CHERNOV: ^7His bravery on the battlefield is beyond question.

SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_103C_CHER.en:
^1CHERNOV: ^7At times I have seen him show mercy
and at others act with complete brutality.

SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_104A_CHER.en: ^1CHERNOV: ^7Just like the rest of the red army.

SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_104B_CHER.en:
^1CHERNOV: ^7But he has also shown mercy
amidst the brutality of the Red army.

SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_105C_CHER.en:
^1CHERNOV: ^7Perhaps heroes need not
question their actions.

SUBTITLE_BER3B_OUT_003A_REZN_A.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7The heart of this army can never be broken.

SUBTITLE_BER3_IGD_000A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7The Germans hang
their cowards from trees.

SUBTITLE_BER3_IGD_000B_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7The Germans hang
their cowards by the neck.

SUBTITLE_BER3_IGD_001A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Make sure you keep hold
of that flag, Chernov.

SUBTITLE_BER3_IGD_006A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Our tanks will have to find
another way around.

SUBTITLE_BER3_IGD_010A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Today is the day of our glorious
vengeance! For ourselves... and for mother Russia!

SUBTITLE_BER3_IGD_012A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7We need to destroy the 88s
before our can armor move up!

SUBTITLE_BER3_IGD_016A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Do whatever it takes to blow
the bastards to hell!!!

SUBTITLE_BER3_IGD_016A_REZN_SAFE.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Do whatever it takes to blow
them to pieces!

SUBTITLE_BER3_INT_000A_REZN_B.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7You will be okay... Do you hear me?

SUBTITLE_BER3_INT_002A_COMM.en:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7Brave comrades.
This day, the Nazi empire will yield
to the iron fist of the Red Army.

SUBTITLE_BER3_INT_003A_REZN_C.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Relax for a few minutes. Breathe deeply.

SUBTITLE_BER3_INT_004A_COMM.en:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7Cut down those in front of you
as though they are but fields of wheat and rye.

SUBTITLE_BER3_INT_005A_REZN_C.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Which do you think will lead us home?
Writing about this war or fighting it?

SUBTITLE_BER3_INT_008A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7If you lack the stomach to kill for your country ...
at least show me that you are willing to die for it.

SUBTITLE_BER3_INT_009A_COMM.en:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7Drown this wretched Germany
in the blood of its own!!!

SUBTITLE_BER3_INT_010A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7We are in the final hours
of Berlin's downfall...

SUBTITLE_BER3_INT_013A_COMM.en:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7Take the left flank and eradicate
whatever scum remains in defense of each building.

SUBTITLE_BER3_INT_015A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7You heard him, comrades...
To the left!

SUBTITLE_BER3_INT_300A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7They flooded their own metro
in an effort to kill us, Dimitri...

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_004A_PLOG.en: ^1US MARINE: ^7You like that?  You piece of shit!

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_010A_PSOU.en: ^1US MARINE: ^7I can't get a clear shot!!!

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_013B_SULL.en:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Since Miller's recon mission was a total fubar... 
We're blind from here on out.

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_014B_SULL.en:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Support squad will hit
the beach just up ahead... Let's move!

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_014C_SULL.en:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Jackson's squad will hit the beach just up ahead...
Let's move.

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_016A_SULL.en: ^1SULLIVAN: ^7Stay on your toes...  They could be anywhere.

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_017A_PHIL.en: ^1US MARINE: ^7Sarge, you ever see a Banzai charge?

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_020A_PHIL.en: ^1US MARINE: ^7Some crazy tactic they pull when...

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_023A_PSOU.en: ^1US MARINE: ^7Shit...  Nearly had a freakin' heart attack.

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_023A_PSOU_SAFE.en: ^1US MARINE: ^7Nearly had a freakin' heart attack.

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_026A_PHIL.en: ^1US MARINE: ^7Looks like a temple or some shit...

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_027A_PSOU.en: ^1US MARINE: ^7What do the Japanese pray to anyway?

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_029A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Jackson's squad should be there
any minute now...

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_029B_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Support squad should be
there any minute now...

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_033A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Japanese infantry in the river...
Moving in from the west!

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_035A_SULL_E.en:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Roebuck, MG on the right...
The other one's mine.

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_038A_SULL.en:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7I want to get through the rest
of this quick and clean.

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_042A_SULL_B.en:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7These bastards are full of surprises...
I don't like surprises.

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_042A_SULL_SAFE.en:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7The Japanese are full of surprises...
I don't like surprises.

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_048A_SULL.en:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Radio command...
Find out if another unit came in ahead of us.

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_051A_SULL.en:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Miller, use your knife and put
a hole in that barrel.

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_054A_SULL.en: ^1SULLIVAN: ^7Time ain't on our side! Hit that barrel!

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_065B_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Miller, keep a watch outside.
We don't want any more surprises.

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_080A_SULL.en: ^1SULLIVAN: ^7I do not want anyone left behind.

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_116A_PAYE.en: ^1US MARINE: ^7Get your damn hands off me!

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_118A_JAS1.en: ^1JAPANESE SOLDIER: ^7You should not have come here.

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_119A_PAYE.en:
^1US MARINE: ^7You hear that outside?
You should all surrender, now.

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_206A_SULL.en:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Hudson's squad's landing
over there on the right!

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_208A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Damn!...  Timer's fried...
We may only get a few minutes before detonation.

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_208A_ROEB_SAFE.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Timer's fried...  We may only
get a few minutes before detonation.

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_209A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Miller, get to work planting those charges...

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_210A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7The timer got fried in that last fire fight...
We may only get a few minutes before detonation.

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_211A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Sullivan... We had to jerry-rig the charges!

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_212A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7We need to get
to the extraction point ASAP!

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_304A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7I need you to cover me
while I plant the charges!

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_500A_SULL.en:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Don't leave so much as one
of the bastards standing!

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_501A_SULL.en:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Watch our flank!
Don't let 'em surround us!

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_502A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Put 'em down fast!
Don't give 'em a chance to charge us!

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_514A_SULL.en: ^1SULLIVAN: ^7Don't let them get another crew on it!

SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_520A_SULL.en: ^1SULLIVAN: ^7Bail out before it hits the camp!

SUBTITLE_MAK1_INT_000A_JPOF_AB.en:
^1JAPANESE OFFICER: ^7You think because you say nothing...
You are strong?

SUBTITLE_MAK1_INT_003A_MITC_B.en: ^1PVT. PYLE: ^7Don't tell them a fucking thing!

SUBTITLE_MAK1_INT_009D_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7We're gonna make it out of here...  Just stay with me.

SUBTITLE_MAK1_INT_010B_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7We're gonna make them pay for what they've done!

SUBTITLE_MAK1_INT_014A_SULL.en:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Grab a rifle.
We're gonna tear this place apart.

SUBTITLE_MAK1_OUT_002A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7You're gonna be okay, just hang in there.

SUBTITLE_MAK1_OUT_105A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Sullivan, ever been in a fight like that?

SUBTITLE_OKI2_IGD_002A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Major Gordon's ordered another
attack on the enemy stronghold beyond this ridge.

SUBTITLE_OKI2_IGD_007A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7We got a heavily fortified MG in that bunker.
